description: An observe-only lifecycle log for agent sessions, with a status panel and webhook notifications.

env.name: PI_EVENTS_WEBHOOK_URL
env.title: Notification webhook
env.description: Optional http(s) URL that receives a JSON POST for every recorded lifecycle event, e.g. https://example.test/webhook.

env.name: PI_EVENTS_STATE_PATH
env.title: Shared event log file
env.description: Optional absolute SQLite path, shared by the server and agent copies. Defaults to $XDG_STATE_HOME/t3code-pi-events-plugin/events.sqlite.
